items.name: GPT-6 Astra
items.why: OpenAI 的最新旗艦模型，具備自主處理網站創建、遊戲開發、網路安全和編碼等多種任務的能力，並在遊戲環境中展現出卓越的空間推理能力。
items.why_en: OpenAI's latest flagship model, capable of autonomously handling tasks such as website creation, game development, cybersecurity, and coding, demonstrating exceptional spatial reasoning in game environments.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.why: Anthropic 最新發佈的旗艦模型，專為編碼和知識工作設計，在代理編碼基準測試中表現出色，並大幅降低了快取讀取費用，是 Claude Fable 5 的重要升級。
items.why_en: Anthropic's latest flagship model, designed for coding and knowledge work, excelling in agentic coding benchmarks and significantly reducing cache read fees, representing a major upgrade to Claude Fable 5.

items.name: Nimble Fox
items.why: 專為 Unity 開發者設計的 AI 遊戲創建工具，能根據功能請求直接在 Unity 專案中實現工作版本，顯著加速遊戲開發流程。
items.why_en: An AI game creation tool specifically designed for Unity developers, capable of implementing working versions directly within Unity projects based on feature requests, significantly accelerating game development workflows.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.why: Google DeepMind 最新推出的 Flash 模型，以其速度和效率著稱，為通用編碼任務提供強大支援，對遊戲開發中的快速迭代至關重要。
items.why_en: Google DeepMind's newly released Flash model, known for its speed and efficiency, provides strong support for general coding tasks, crucial for rapid iteration in game development.

items.name: Cursor
items.why: 領先的 AI 優先整合開發環境 (IDE)，其 3.x 版本持續迭代，提供強大的代理模式、多檔案編輯和模型整合功能，是 AI 編程領域的重要工具。
items.why_en: A leading AI-first integrated development environment (IDE) with continuous iteration in its 3.x versions, offering powerful agent modes, multi-file editing, and model integration, making it a crucial tool in AI programming.

items.name: AI Studio 1.1

items.why_en: Reallusion's 3D-guided AI rendering toolset received its first major update, now available as a standalone application with 4K output and AI Character Sheet generation, beneficial for game character creation.

items.name: Pixal3D

items.why_en: A new model released in 2026, Pixal3D was natively integrated into ComfyUI at the end of August, making it a commercially viable and easy-to-use 3D generation tool.

items.name: Autodesk Wonder 3D
